review_method: full-range static source and fixture review; no provider invocation; no candidate tests claimed

findings.issue: Tests are outside every registered Cargo test target, and fixture lookup hardcodes ../../p22-providers/tests. The workspace will not run them and a fresh checkout cannot resolve this private worktree name.
findings.required_fix: Register the target via integration owner; resolve fixtures from checked-in repository paths with no candidate-worktree name. Demonstrate exact cargo test target in a clean isolated checkout.

findings.issue: An arbitrary screen name or transcript containing grok fabricates a provider identity. --model argv is a requested configuration, not observed provider execution identity. This conflicts with requested-versus-observed semantics.
findings.required_fix: Keep executable-verified identity separate from untrusted hints and requested_model. Unknown evidence stays unknown. Add quoted-output, misleading screen name, conflicting executable and argv-only model cases.

findings.issue: Whole-buffer serde_json::Value parsing accepts duplicate JSON keys, scalar/non-event JSON and an unterminated final line. No journal offsets, sticky failure or drain watermark bind the output to one observed session. Grok repeats the same parser shape.
findings.required_fix: Use a bounded incremental provider observation decoder with strict duplicate detection and explicit framing/EOF behavior. Keep observation and protocol validation separate; unknown events must not grant authority. Integrate shared session-journal watermark checks before claiming managed conformance.

findings.issue: The launch validator permits 128 arguments of 64KiB each without the shared total argv and serialized LaunchSpec envelope limits. AGY/Grok launch builders similarly return unbound argv without cwd, pinned configuration or supervision/admission seam.
findings.required_fix: Route builders through existing shared limits and typed launch-preparation boundary. No implicit grant from parsed help or opaque references. Test final serialized bytes and combinations, not per-argument bounds alone.

retained_positive_evidence: Capability fixtures explicitly identify help/version-only probes and synthetic stream vectors; auth, usage, resume and permission semantics remain unsupported.
No runtime module or Cargo registration was changed by this candidate, so it is not active in the main runtime.
next_action: Implement only scoped offline hardening and registered counterexample tests in a new isolated candidate; integration owner handles module/Cargo wiring. Real qualification waits for admission/resource prerequisites and bounded explicit run review.
